title: Leak event
description: DESCRIPTIVE, NOT NORMATIVE. Generated from firmware source at FW 1.8.0 and re-verified field by field against FW 2.1.4 (branch fix/2.1.4, release commit "chore(release): 2.1.4", whose parent is x-nearest-commit). x-source line numbers are from the 1.8.0 generation and are STALE; fields added or changed for 2.1.4 cite functions instead. This is not a specification and not a proposal; it records what the device emits today. Plane: D2C telemetry. `required` lists only keys present in the minimal payload, i.e. those always emitted for this message type.

schema.description: Wire-contract identifier. Constant; bump signals a breaking payload change. Range/enum: Fixed literal "eflostop.v2".

ts.description: Device wall-clock at message BUILD time. The whole message is destroyed (never sent, never buffered) if ts < 1704067200, so a pre-SNTP leak event is lost permanently. Units: seconds (Unix epoch, UTC). Range/enum: >= 1704067200 (2024-01-01T00:00:00Z).

id.description: Immutable hub id derived from the WiFi STA MAC in eFuse. Same string used as the DPS registration id and the MQTT client id. Range/enum: "GW-" + 12 uppercase hex.

short_id.description: Last 2 bytes of the STA MAC as 4 hex chars. Also the SoftAP SSID suffix (WiFi-Hub-XXXX) the installer matches during setup. Range/enum: 4 uppercase hex chars.

name.description: User-assigned hub name from twin desired hub_name or C2D set_hub_name. NOTE the opposite convention on the twin plane, where hub_name is always emitted as "". Range/enum: free text, max 31 chars (HUB_NAME_MAX_LEN). Presence: conditional: OMITTED when the stored name is empty.

fw.description: Hub firmware version, read at runtime from the ESP-IDF app descriptor (PROJECT_VER). Never a hardcoded string. Range/enum: "2.1.4" for this release (CMakeLists.txt:12); "0.0.0" if the descriptor is empty.

uptime_s.description: Seconds since boot from the monotonic esp_timer. On an offline-buffer replay this is the ORIGINAL build-time value, possibly from a previous boot. Units: seconds. Range/enum: >= 0.

type.description: Envelope discriminator. Tells the backend which `data` shape to expect. Range/enum: enum: "lifecycle" | "snapshot" | "event".

event.description: Event discriminator inside data. The single most important routing key for the backend event log. Range/enum across the whole D2C plane, 16 values: online | valve_state_changed | leak_detected | leak_cleared | cmd_ack | auto_close | auto_close_blocked_override | auto_close_reenabled | rmleak_cleared | rmleak_auto_cleared | water_access_override_enabled | water_access_override_expired | device_offline | device_recovered | rules_engine | health_engine (valve_flood_detected / valve_flood_cleared were retired in 1.9.0). The enum below lists the values this message type carries. Presence: always in lifecycle and in every event shape; ABSENT in snapshot.

source_type.description: Which device detected the water. Range/enum: ble_leak_sensor | lora | valve (the valve's own flood probe, since 1.9.0). Presence: always.

valve_id.description: The provisioned valve's MAC, when source_type is valve. Third key, same position as sensor_id. Range/enum: uppercase colon MAC. Presence: source_type valve only.

sensor_id.description: The sensor's id: "0x" + 8 uppercase hex (lora) or uppercase colon MAC (ble_leak_sensor). Third key. Presence: source_type lora / ble_leak_sensor only.

leak_state.description: true on leak_detected, false on leak_cleared. Presence: always.

battery.description: Battery of the reporting device. null when unknown (0xFF), for any source (2.1.4; a valve with no reading used to report 0). Units: percent. Presence: always.

code.description: Machine-readable room code from the sensor_meta table; "unknown" when no metadata is stored. Range/enum: enum, 13 values.

label.description: User-entered free-text location label. Range/enum: free text, max 31 chars; "" when no metadata is stored.

location.description: Installed-location metadata. Presence: ALWAYS, for every source; the valve always reports {"code":"unknown","label":""} (sensor_meta cannot address a valve).

rssi.description: RSSI of the packet that reported the change. Units: dBm. Presence: sensors only (lora / ble_leak_sensor); ABSENT for the valve.

valve_state.description: Valve position sampled at detection. Range/enum: open | closed | unknown. Presence: source_type valve only.
valve_state.x-source: has_valve_ext in telemetry_v2_publish_leak_event(); vlk_state in iothub_task()

rmleak.description: The valve's RMLEAK latch sampled at detection, BEFORE any interlock write. Presence: source_type valve only.

fw_version.description: Valve firmware revision. Presence: source_type valve only, and OMITTED when the DIS read has not succeeded (no null variant).

data.description: Leak event: one family for water detected anywhere. Required core in fixed order: event, source_type, <valve_id|sensor_id>, leak_state, battery, location; then the source extras. Presence: always.
data.x-source: telemetry_v2_publish_leak_event() main/telemetry/telemetry_v2.c; call sites in iothub_task() Phase 3
